title: BrightBlog
description: BrightBlog is a vibrant and user-friendly platform for creating engaging blog posts with text and multiple images. It features a cheerful design and intuitive image upload functionality.

features.name: Create Blog Posts
features.description: Allows users to create blog posts with text and upload multiple images to enhance their content.

features.name: Image Upload with Preview
features.description: Provides a cute and bright interface for uploading images, including drag-and-drop functionality and a preview feature.

features.name: Responsive Design
features.description: Ensures the blog webpage is accessible and visually appealing across various devices, including mobile and desktop.

constraints: The webpage must support modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
Image uploads should be limited to common formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF) and a maximum file size of 5MB per image.
target_users: Individuals who want to create visually appealing blogs with text and images, including casual bloggers and content creators.
data_requirements: The application should store blog posts and uploaded images in a secure database, with proper indexing for efficient retrieval.
